findings.title: story reopen with the story branch gone from the remote does not name the branch
findings.repro: Close a story, delete its story branch from the remote (`git push origin --delete gh-6-close-me`), run `norn story reopen gh-6`. Expected: refused naming the branch (gh-6-close-me). Observed: exit 3 `unknown_story` 'no story branch for gh-6', do_instead 'check the story key' — the branch is not named and the hint points at the key, which is right. (A missing slice branch is named correctly; not_closed and issue_closed refusals pass.)
findings.detail: restorable() refuses `no story branch for ${key}` / 'check the story key' / unknown_story when pushedStory returns null; B42 asks for the refusal to name the branch (as the slice-branch case already does with branch_missing). Evidence: B42.md.

criteria.how: In a Herdr pane run `bun packages/cli/src/main.ts status --watch --pane` in a throwaway repo: expect a pane split below running the cockpit; outside Herdr expect a refusal with do_instead `norn status --watch`. Observed here by accident: it opened pane w9G:p2 below this one (label norn, cwd the throwaway repo), closed afterwards; the pane ran `norn status --watch` from PATH (the released 0.11.1, which rejected --watch), so with a dev build it runs the installed norn, not the launching one.
